name: Attaching Project Context documents on an agent and a skill persists across a reload
description: The FIRST mutating flow in this suite (R-11) — every other flow targets read-only seeded data (e2e/README.md), but AC-13/AC-14/AC-15 are specifically about persistence, which a read-only flow cannot exercise. Safe only because the hermetic stack's Postgres is ephemeral and fresh per run, and because flow 11 runs strictly after flow 10 (lexical filename order — run.ts sorts specs/*.flow.json) so nothing it writes is visible to an already-completed assertion. Toggles a document on the seeded Security Reviewer agent's Context tab, hard-reloads (a fresh 'open', not a client-side navigation, so the check is against the SERVER, not React Query's in-memory cache), and confirms it is still attached (AC-13). Attaches a second document in a deliberate click order and confirms BOTH survive the same reload, exercising the persisted `order` column the same way a drag would (AC-14) — literal pointer-drag / keyboard-arrow reordering is NOT driven here because agent-browser's allowed, deterministic command set (open/wait/find — see AGENTS.md) has no drag or key-press primitive; the pure reorder/dedup logic itself (`arrangeDocs`/`moveItem`/`attachedPathsInOrder`) is covered by the hermetic unit tests in client/src/components/context-docs/helpers.test.ts. Then attaches a document on the seeded uncovered-branch-gate skill's Context tab and confirms it too survives a reload (AC-15).

steps.label: switch to the agent's Context tab
hard reload back to the agents list (fresh page load, not SPA nav)
switch to the Context tab again
attach a second document, after the first (order matters)
switch to the Context tab again
both documents, and their order, survived the reload (AC-14)
switch to the skill's Context tab
attach a document on the skill
hard reload back to the skills list
switch to the Context tab again
